senses.gloss: m. (ἐφίππιον, ephippium) saddle cloth, a figurative expression for the protuberances of the human buttock; v. אַיִן I.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:19:1">Koh. R. to III, 19</cite> (ref. to ‘the advantage of man over beast’ Koh. l. c.) <he>ואפופרין כפוי עליו וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) and an ephippium is pressed over it (the lock of the buttock) in order that he may not look as hideous as a beast; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> <cite ref="A02699"><he>אפיפורין</he></cite> (and otherwise, to be corrected after Koh. R. l. c.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 969:1">Yalk. Koh. 969</cite> <he>אפיפורי פרוסה על רגליו</he> (corr. acc.).
